decisions.reason: The drink mix is distant from the firm's core waste-to-value and engineering knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret and improve this consumer product.
Modular waste-to-energy extensions directly build on the firm's established energy and plant knowledge, enabling it to absorb feedback and improve them.
Waste oil to energy is a core waste-to-energy application backed by the firm's in-house R&D and university cooperation, making learning and improvement likely.
Plastic waste to fuel is close to the firm's existing waste conversion capabilities, so the firm can assimilate early market results and keep improving it.
